title: Insight 1: Nov 1 ride brushed Z2 ceiling
description: Your Nov 1 ride averaged 158 bpm, just 1 beat below the Z2 upper limit (159 bpm). Keep easy rides comfortably in the lower half of Z2 to preserve recovery.

title: Insight 2: Oct 25 climb density highest
description: The Oct 25 ride packed 551 m elevation into 2h18m (239 m/h) — the steepest climbing rate recently. Consider a flatter route for pure endurance days to reduce leg fatigue.

title: Insight 3: Three rides in four days (Nov 5–8)
description: You rode Nov 5, 6, and 8 with readiness dropping to 71 on Nov 6 after only 5h sleep. Insert a rest or very easy spin day after back-to-back efforts.

title: Insight 4: Consistent 2-hour long rides
description: Your longest rides are now 62 km (Nov 1 & 8) at ~2 hours. Gently extend one weekend ride to 70 km next month to nudge endurance without pressure.

title: Insight 5: HR and power zones aligned
description: LTHR 175 bpm and FTP 203 W produce matching zone boundaries (Z2 HR 139–159, Z2 power 112–152 W). No recalibration needed unless you do a formal test.

title: Insight 6: Polarized balance looks good
description: Rides average in Z2 with brief Z4–Z5 spikes (max HR 179–195), suggesting ~80% easy / 20% hard. Keep conversational pace on easy days to maintain this split.

title: Insight 7: Sleep debt hit readiness Nov 6
description: Readiness fell to 71 after 5h9m sleep on Nov 6 and consecutive rides. Prioritize 7+ hours sleep after hard days; HRV rebounded to 68 today — good sign.

title: Insight 8: Strong sprint power shows neuromuscular zip
description: Peak 10s power hit 981 W (Nov 5) and 579–583 W on other rides. One weekly strength session (squats, lunges, core) will sustain this snap and prevent injury.

title: Insight 9: VO2max steady — add targeted intervals
description: Cycling VO2max holds at 49.0. Try 2×/week: 4×4 min at 215–223 W (106–110% FTP) with 4 min easy spin to lift the ceiling.

title: Insight 10: FTP estimate ready for verification
description: Current FTP 203 W comes from 95% of your 214 W 20-min best (Oct 25). Do a fresh 20-min all-out test on a rested week to confirm or raise the number.
